-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.LockArm` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.lockArmS (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Locked :
    mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (HN : IProp GF) (hk : Option val) (Pre Q Post : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match hk with
  | some f =>
    iprop(HF f ∗
        (□ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (f (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗ (Q ∗ W ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ W ∗ Post))
  | none => iprop(HN ∗ mvcc.lockNilSpec bt RT WT W P HN Locked ∗ (P ∗ Pre ∗ HN ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post))

theorem mvcc.hookP_agree_lc2 (E : CoPset) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P P' : IProp GF) : £ 1 ∗ mvcc.hookP
    γ P ∗ mvcc.hookP γ P' ⊢ |={E}=> □ (P -∗ P') ∗ □ (P' -∗ P)

def mvcc.cmpCb (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c cp rev : Int) (Fok Fce Ffr : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∀ L,
        ⌜cp < rev ∧ c ≤ rev ∧ rev < ↑(List.length L)⌝ -∗
          mvcc.slotX γ 1 L c ∗
              mvcc.api.absPart γ.api (Qp.half 1).half L c ∗
                mvcc.api.pndPart γ.api (mvcc.pndW γ) none ={⊤ \ ↑mvcc.writerN}=∗
            mvcc.slotX γ 1 L rev ∗
              mvcc.api.absPart γ.api (Qp.half 1).half L rev ∗ mvcc.api.pndPart γ.api (mvcc.pndW γ) none ∗ Fok) ∧
      (∀ L, ⌜rev ≤ c⌝ -∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 L c ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 L c ∗ Fce) ∧
        ∀ L, ⌜↑(List.length L) - 1 < rev ∧ c < ↑(List.length L)⌝ -∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 L c ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 L c ∗ Ffr)

theorem mvcc.lockCtxM_pre (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (hk : Option val) (Pre Q Post : IProp
    GF) : mvcc.lockCtxM γ P hk Pre Q Post ⊢ mvcc.lockBackM γ P hk ∗ Pre

theorem mvcc.lockArmS_none (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Locked
    : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (HN Pre Q Post : IProp GF) : mvcc.lockArmS bt RT WT W P HF Locked HN
    none Pre Q Post = iprop(HN ∗ mvcc.lockNilSpec bt RT WT W P HN Locked ∗ (P ∗ Pre ∗ HN ={⊤}=∗ P ∗
    Post))

def mvcc.lockCtxM (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (hk : Option val) (Pre Q Post : IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  match hk with
  | some f => iprop(mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗ mvcc.csContract P f Pre Q Post)
  | none => iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb ∗ Pre ∗ (P ∗ Pre ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post))

theorem mvcc.cmpCb_refl (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rev cp : Int) : ⊢ mvcc.cmpCb γ rev cp rev iprop(True)
    iprop(True) iprop(False)

def mvcc.lockBackM (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (hk : Option val) : IProp GF :=
  match hk with
  | some f => mvcc.hookOk γ P f
  | none => iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb)

theorem mvcc.lockBackM_some (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) : mvcc.lockBackM γ P
    (some f) = mvcc.hookOk γ P f

theorem mvcc.lockCtxM_some (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (Pre Q Post : IProp GF) :
    mvcc.lockCtxM γ P (some f) Pre Q Post = iprop(mvcc.hookOk γ P f ∗ mvcc.csContract P f Pre Q
    Post)

theorem mvcc.lockBackM_none (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) : mvcc.lockBackM γ P none =
    iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb)

theorem mvcc.lockCtxM_none (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P Pre Q Post : IProp GF) : mvcc.lockCtxM γ P none
    Pre Q Post = iprop(mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ mvcc.kbHookNil γ.kb ∗ Pre ∗ (P ∗ Pre ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ Post))

theorem mvcc.lockArmS_some (bt : GoInterfaceOk) (RT WT W P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Locked
    : mvcc.Puts → IProp GF) (HN : IProp GF) (f : val) (Pre Q Post : IProp GF) : mvcc.lockArmS bt RT
    WT W P HF Locked HN (some f) Pre Q Post = iprop(HF f ∗ (□ □ ∀ Φ, P ∗ Pre -∗ ▷ (Q -∗ Φ (intoVal
    ())) -∗ WP (f (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗ (Q ∗ W ={⊤}=∗ P ∗ W ∗ Post))
